Data Reporting, Transparency, and Collection Requirements - The Department of Energy shall collect and publish data related to AI data centers, including all financial vehicles involved in the facility’s operation; water usage; energy usage and infrastructure needs; on- and off-site greenhouse gas emissions associated with facility operation; fenceline air quality monitoring; worker wage and benefit information; temporary and permanent jobs created; wastewater discharge and thermal outputs; cooling chemicals used; noise levels; certification of no utilization of federal, state, and local subsidies; and agreements related to land acquisitions, utilities, and government entities.
